_doc: Bowmaster line (spec #332, ticket B2 #334): an empty skeleton. Each Bowmaster skill ticket (B7-B11) appends its own definitions in its own marked region; until a key is defined, the job's pool entry for it is inert (never offered, never learned). Shared keys with Bowman (arrow_blow, bow_double_shot, arrow_bomb) stay in skills/bowman.json until B7 moves them here. B8 #340 appends arrow_rain and dragons_breath (kept together after the earlier tickets' entries).

arrow_rain.name: Arrow Rain
arrow_rain.desc: Calls a rain of arrows down around you. The damage lands a moment after the cast.
arrow_rain._tier: Tier A: WZ damage 60..160%, the symmetric box (+-170 -> +-210 by +-100), mobCount 6, weapon 45 (bow), effect/hit/special art and Use/Hit sounds. Tier C (#340, GAME_DESIGN 7.45): the eight survivor ranks, a box cast anchored where the caster stood that strikes 0.5s later (the delayed-strike seam of Meteor Shower), min_targets 1, 5s cooldown, 0.6s held weapon stance, the special node read as eight arrows falling 230px over 0.15s, one every 90ms across the box (art only), rarity bonuses. Untuned.

dragons_breath.name: Dragon's Breath
dragons_breath.desc: Looses a dragon-fire arrow that pierces a line of monsters and knocks each one back.
dragons_breath._tier: Tier A: WZ damage 42..100%, mobCount 4..6, range 440 (read from the level), prop 100, weapon 45 (bow), ball/hit/effect art and Use/Hit sounds. Tier C (#340, GAME_DESIGN 7.45): the eight survivor ranks, nearest auto-cast with its own ball (no ammo sprite), 3.5s cooldown, 700px/s, 16px radius, `pierce_field` mobCount (the arrow strikes mobCount monsters, so it pierces mobCount - 1), a 180px knock-back that always rolls (prop 100; bosses are damaged and not moved), 0.6s held weapon stance, rarity bonuses. Untuned.
